MInstanceID.description: Identifier of the M-Instance (Virtual Space) where this Position is defined.

UEnvironmentID.description: Identifier of the U-Environment (Real Space) where this Position is defined.

PositionID.description: Unique identifier of this Position instance.

PositionTime.description: Time this Position instance was produced.

General.description: General classification data of the Object.

CoordType.description: Coordinate type: one of Cartesian, Spherical, Cylindrical, Geodetic, Toroidal.

ObjectType.description: Type of the Object: one of Digital Human, Generic.

MediaType.description: Media type: one of Speech, Audio, Visual, 3D Model, Audio-Visual, Haptic, Smell, RADAR, LiDAR, Ultrasound.

CartPosition.description: Cartesian position (X, Y, Z) in metres of the Object's representative point, in the reference frame (by default, ISO 8855: right-handed, X east, Y north, Z up).

CartPositionAccuracy.description: Accuracy of each Cartesian position component (X, Y, Z) in metres.

SpherPosition.description: Spherical position (r, φ, θ) in the reference frame: r, the distance from the origin, in metres; φ, the azimuth, by default measured from +X towards +Y, and θ, the elevation above the X-Y plane, in degrees.

SpherPositionAccuracy.description: Accuracy of each spherical position component (r, φ, θ).

CartVelocity.description: Cartesian velocity (X, Y, Z) in metres/s, in the reference frame.

CartVelocityAccuracy.description: Accuracy of each Cartesian velocity component (X, Y, Z) in metres/s.

SpherVelocity.description: Spherical velocity (r, φ, θ) in metres/s and degrees/s.

SpherVelocityAccuracy.description: Accuracy of each spherical velocity component (r, φ, θ).

CartAccel.description: Cartesian acceleration (X, Y, Z) in metres/s², in the reference frame.

CartAccelAccuracy.description: Accuracy of each Cartesian acceleration component (X, Y, Z) in metres/s².

SpherAccel.description: Spherical acceleration (r, φ, θ) in metres/s² and degrees/s².

SpherAccelAccuracy.description: Accuracy of each spherical acceleration component (r, φ, θ).

SpatialQualifier.description: Spatial Qualifier stating the frame, the axes and their handedness, the units and the conventions of this Position.

DataXMData.description: MPAI-PTF Data Exchange Metadata providing provenance, authorisation, legal, security, and confidence information associated with this Position in a trusted data exchange context.

DescrMetadata.description: Human-readable descriptive metadata of the Position instance (plain text, max 2048 characters).
